name: Down at the Docks
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
I have heard tales of the mighty ships that sail between Ratchet and Booty Bay!  That would be so cool to sail on the ocean and fight in many great sea battles.  Maybe I will be a mighty Horde sailor when I grow up!  Yeah!

Would you take me to see the Ratchet docks, please?  I promise I won't get into the water or cause any trouble - I just want to see the big boats and smell the salty sea water!  Yeah!
narrative.objectives: Take your ward to the docks of Ratchet in the Barrens.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Wow, the ocean is HUGE! There were a lot of sea gulls and stuff too - It's just as noisy and as bustling as I thought it would be. There are pirates near by too - so cool!

Thank you for taking me to Ratchet, adventurer. That was so awesome!
narrative.endText: Go to the docks of Ratchet in the Barrens.
